snippet.title: 「Neon Clash -Echoes of the Lost-」Nintendo Switch™ - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The latest from AmuLit! Check out the teaser for Neon Clash -Echoes of the Lost-, an upcoming download-exclusive game for the Nintendo Switch™ !!

"To combat evil, you must use evil.
 Ideals will do nothing to change the world."

◆X（Twitter）
Neon Clash -Echoes of the Lost-：https://x.com/NeonClash_EL
AmuLit：https://x.com/AmuLit_Global

◆Official Site◆
https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english

◆Official Portal Site◆
https://products.voltage.co.jp/switch/english

◆Participating Creators◆
Director: Ichika Shiina
Scenario: Ririka Yoshimura
Illustrator: Takao 
Background Art: Studio Cocolo Co., Ltd.
BGM: Shunsuke Tsuchiya
Theme Song:Shihoko Hirata

――――――――――――――

*AmuLit is Voltage Inc's new brand for console platforms.
*Neon Clash -  Echoes of the Lost  - is the official title for Project Code Neon Mafia, announced in 2023.
